connector.name: Picdefenseio MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Image risk scoring, EXIF, reverse-image backlinks, and image content detection via PicDefense.io.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.picdefense.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rchanllc account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-Token
headers.description: Your PicDefense.io token in the form USERID:APIKEY.

env.name: PICDEFENSE_API_TOKEN
env.description: Your PicDefense.io token in the form USERID:APIKEY. Get it at https://app.picdefense.io/?returnUrl=https://app.picdefense.io/dashboard/settings
